stories.title: 5-team deal sends Watson to Cavs, Strus to Clips
stories.summary: The Cavaliers, Nuggets and Clippers have agreed on a trade that will send Peyton Watson to Cleveland and Max Strus to Los Angeles, sources told ESPN. Watson will sign a new four-year, $88 million deal to join the Cavs, his agents said.

stories.title: O's bash MLB technology after near-HR ruled foul
stories.summary: The Orioles criticized MLB for being behind on technology after Pete Alonso's deep fly to left was ruled foul and the call was upheld on a review Wednesday night against the Yankees.

stories.title: Sources: Texans' Higgins tears ACL, out for season
stories.summary: Texans second-year wideout Jayden Higgins will miss the season after suffering a torn ACL during a joint practice with the Raiders, sources told NFL Network.
